moves.name: Summer Sky Feather Dance
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition: When this move is used.

Never misses. Lowers the Attack and Sp. Atk of all opposing sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. Turns the field of play’s zone into a Flying Zone. (A Flying Zone powers up Flying-type attacks.) Raises the evasiveness of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 2 ranks.
